title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack, Google Cloud
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
  
  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience programming in Java or C++.
* 3 years of experience programming in JavaScript or TypeScript.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
* 5 years of experience with data structures/algorithms.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.

**About The Job**
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
  
  
With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Write and test product or system development code.
* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
description:
**Why Harvey**
At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
  
  
This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.
  
  
Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
  
  
At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Product Backend Engineer on Harvey’s product engineering team, you will design and operate the backend systems that turn cutting-edge AI capabilities into seamless, dependable product experiences. You’ll build secure, multi-tenant services, orchestrate interactions with LLMs and agentic tools, and help define the backend architecture that powers Harvey’s rapidly expanding product surface. Your work will have immediate business and customer impact as you ship the foundational systems behind our next generation of AI products.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Collaborate closely with Product to prioritize customer-focused work and deliver reliable features quickly in a fast-moving environment.
* Design and own backend services and APIs that power Harvey’s web applications, workflows, and integrations.
* Model and manage data in Postgres and related data stores to support low-latency, reliable user experiences.
* Build secure, multi-tenant, permissions-aware systems with appropriate auditing for enterprise and government customers.
* Implement backend features and workflows that use LLMs and agentic tools, orchestrating calls to our AI systems from robust, well-structured services.
* Collaborate with frontend, product, and design partners to shape solutions, define clear API contracts, and ship features end-to-end.
* Add meaningful logging, metrics, and tracing so services are observable, debuggable, and ready for on-call ownership.
* Improve performance and scalability by profiling bottlenecks, tuning queries, and refining service boundaries as usage grows.
* Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and an on-call rotation for the services you own.

**What You Have**

* 5+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating production web applications or SaaS products.
* Track record of building fast-growing SaaS products by leveraging PWA technologies
* Track record of shipping highly intuitive products, strong attention to detail
* Strong programming skills in Python and experience with a modern web framework (e.g., FastAPI or Flask).
* Hands-on experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres)
* Solid understanding of API design, authentication/authorization, background job patterns, and robust error handling.
* Experience building for Cloud Infrastructure such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Comfort operating services in production using logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerts, including participation in an on-call rotation.

**Additional Information**

* Work eligibility: Must be authorized to work in India. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

* Maintain parity with legacy system behavior where required.
* Develop and maintain automated tests and perform regression testing against existing systems.
* Collaborate with senior engineers and architects to understand technical requirements and implementation approaches.

* Good understanding of React.js , including components, hooks, and basic state management.
* Good understanding of .NET / C# , with exposure to .NET 10 or willingness to learn and ramp up quickly.
* Good understanding of SQL Server and relational databases , including reading queries, understanding existing tables, and testing against development databases.
* Good understanding of REST APIs, relational databases , and full-stack web application architecture.
* Hands-on exposure to AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf , or similar tools, or strong willingness to adopt them.
* Good debugging and problem-solving skills with the ability to ask relevant questions when required.
* Clear communication skills and a collaborative attitude.
* Ability to work effectively with and learn from senior engineers.

* React.js
* .NET / C#
* SQL Server
* REST APIs
* Full-Stack Web Development
* Relational Databases
* Basic State Management
* Debugging & Troubleshooting
* AI-Assisted Development Tools

* Exposure to legacy .NET Framework or Web Forms .
* Academic or personal projects involving React.js and/or .NET .
* Exposure to Git-based development workflows .
* Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines .
* Interest in application modernization and migration projects.
* Experience with automated testing and regression testing.

Sonata Software is an AI-first modernization engineering company that helps enterprises transform legacy systems into intelligent, scalable business platforms. Powered by its Platformation™ framework and Harmoni.AI platform , Sonata delivers AI-led modernization across cloud, data, AI, Dynamics, test automation, and managed services.
  
  
Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Sonata has more than $1.2 billion in revenue and 6,400+ AI engineers supporting global delivery across regions including the US, UK, India, Malaysia, Mexico, Australia, DACH, and the Nordics.
  
  
With deep partnerships across Microsoft, AWS, Salesforce, and Snowflake , Sonata helps Fortune 500 enterprises accelerate innovation, improve efficiency, and drive sustainable growth.
  
  
For more information, please visit www.sonata-software.com .

We deliver the industry’s most interoperable data lakehouse through a cloud-native managed service built on Apache Hudi. Onehouse enables organizations to ingest data at scale with minute-level freshness, centrally store it, and make available to any downstream query engine and use case (from traditional analytics to real-time AI / ML).
  
  
We are a team of self-driven, inspired, and seasoned builders that have created large-scale data systems and globally distributed platforms that sit at the heart of some of the largest enterprises out there including Uber, Snowflake, AWS, Linkedin, Confluent and many more. Riding off a fresh $35M Series B backed by Craft, Greylock and Addition Ventures, we're now at $68M total funding and looking for rising talent to grow with us and become future leaders of the team. The Cloud Infrastructure team is the glue that binds all of this together. We enable our data platform and infrastructure teams to be successful by acting as the foundation of a truly cloud native product.
  
  
**The Impact You Will Drive:**

* As a backend engineer at Onehouse, you will get to build highly scalable and extremely reliable platform services, solving deep technical challenges across all of these areas. These distributed systems will be critical to supporting our multi region cloud microservices at scale.

* Collaborate with the team to implement new APIs, database/caching abstractions and services, to support user-facing products, external partner integrations or infrastructure tooling/monitoring systems.

* Uphold a high engineering bar around the code, monitoring, operations, automated testing, release management of the platform.

**What You Bring to the Table:**

* 3+ years of experience as a backend engineer with experience developing and operating microservices in a distributed environment.
* Experience with Kubernetes, gRPC and Java.
* Experience deploying applications on one or more global cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* Operational excellence in monitoring/deploying/testing microservice architectures.
* Great problem-solving skills, a keen eye for details
* Quick decision making, self-driven and able to balance to feature development and tech debt
* Clear communication skills
* Nice to haves (but not required):
* Experience with Go.
* Experience with Firebase or equivalent DB.
* Experience working on a SaaS product.

**How We'll Take Care Of You**

* Equity Compensation; our success is your success with eligible participation in our company equity plan
* Health & Well-being; we'll invest in your physical and mental well-being by reimbursing up to 20,000 INR for your monthly insurance premium

* Generous Time Off; unlimited PTO (mandatory 1 week/year minimum), uncapped sick days and 17 paid company holidays
* Food & Meal Allowance; weekly lunch stipend, in-office snacks/drinks

Optimize for the company, your team, self - in that order. We may fight long and hard in the trenches, take care of your co-workers with empathy. We give more than we take to build the one house, that everyone dreams of being part of.

We are building our company in a very large, fast-growing but highly competitive space. Life will get tough sometimes. We take hardships in the stride, be positive, focus all energy on the path forward and develop a champion's mindset to overcome odds. Always day one!
  
  
**Keep Making It Better Always**
Rome was not built in a day; If we can get 1% better each day for one year, we'll end up thirty-seven times better. This means being organized, communicating promptly, taking even small tasks seriously, tracking all small ideas, and paying it forward.

We have tremendous scope for innovation, but we will still be judged by impact over time. Big, bold ideas still need to be strategized against priorities, broken down, set in rapid motion, measure, refine, repeat. Great execution is what separates promising companies from proven unicorns.

You don't wait to be told what to do — you identify the problem, make a call, and close the loop.

* Design, develop, and own LLM-powered AI agents and RAG-based features end-to-end — from architecture through production — using Python (FastAPI), ReactJS, and frameworks like LangGraph.
* Architect and implement multi-agent systems with orchestrator/specialist patterns, managing agent state, memory, and inter-agent communication at scale.
* Lead integration of OAuth-based third-party connectors (ERP, CRM, productivity, supplier systems) via REST APIs and MCP (Model Context Protocol), with production-grade auth, retry, and error handling.
* Own data layer decisions across PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and vector databases — optimizing for agent memory, retrieval, and scale.
* Design and operate containerized agent services on GCP (GKE, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Vertex AI) — including deployment pipelines, observability, and incident response.
* Implement human-in-the-loop (HITL) patterns — approval gates, edge case escalation, confidence thresholds — within long-running agentic workflows.
* Drive LLM evaluation and observability using LangSmith, RAGAS, or DeepEval — setting quality bars, not just running evals.
* Contribute meaningfully to architectural discussions and code reviews; raise the quality bar for the team.
* Partner with product and senior architects to scope and decompose enterprise procurement use cases into shippable agent workflows.

**Position Requirements**
**Must-Have**

* 1–2 years of engineering experience — what matters is that at least a significant portion of it involved building and shipping LLM-powered systems to production, not just experimenting.
* Masters or Bachelor's in Computer Science or related discipline; IIT, NIT, IIIT, BITS or equivalent strongly preferred.
* Strong production experience in Python (FastAPI) and ReactJS.
* Hands-on experience with LangGraph — stateful, multi-step agent workflows, not just tutorials.
* Demonstrated ability to design multi-agent orchestration — task decomposition, specialist agents, state handoff, failure recovery.
* Solid experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB/Firestore, Redis, and at least one vector database; familiarity with hybrid search and re-ranking.
* Production experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and GCP or equivalent cloud.
* Strong grasp of OAuth 2.0, JWT, and secure API integration patterns.
* Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tooling (LangSmith, RAGAS, DeepEval, or Phoenix).

**Strong Plus**

* Familiarity with MCP and/or A2A protocol for agent interoperability.
* Experience with managed LLM services — Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI — in production.
* Exposure to event streaming (Kafka, Pub/Sub) in agentic or data pipeline contexts.
* Open-source contributions or shipped personal projects in the agent/LLM space — a strong signal here carries more weight than years of experience elsewhere.

**Who You Are**

* You've already built things most engineers with your experience haven't — and you have the GitHub history, shipped product, or war stories to prove it.
* You own outcomes, not just tasks — you track a problem from requirement to production without being chased.
* You've debugged agents that hallucinated, looped, or failed silently and know how to build guardrails.
* You make pragmatic calls — you know when to reach for a framework and when to write plain Python.

About the role

We are hiring a Senior Android Developer to design, build and ship high-quality Android apps used by real customers at scale. You will own features end to end, shape the app's architecture, and raise the engineering bar for the team.

This role suits an engineer with 5–8 years of hands-on Android experience, deep Kotlin knowledge, strong fundamentals in architecture and testing, and the judgement to make sound technical trade-offs. You will work with product, design, backend and QA, and report to the Engineering lead.

What you will do

* Design and build Android features end to end, from technical design through release and post-launch monitoring.
* Define and evolve the app architecture (MVVM/MVI, Clean Architecture or similar), modularisation and dependency injection.
* Write clean, testable, well-documented Kotlin code and set the standard through thoughtful code reviews.
* Build modern UI with Jetpack Compose (and legacy Views where needed) that follows Material Design and supports accessibility.
* Own performance: startup time, memory, battery, networking, and smooth rendering, using Android Studio Profiler and Perfetto to find and fix bottlenecks.
* Integrate REST/GraphQL APIs, push notifications (FCM), analytics, payments and third-party SDKs securely and reliably.
* Build and maintain unit, UI and screenshot tests, and keep CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Bitrise or similar) fast and stable.
* Manage Google Play releases, staged rollouts, crash monitoring and compatibility across devices and OS versions.
* Mentor mid-level and junior engineers and help the team make good technical decisions.
* Partner with product, design, backend and QA to scope work, flag risks early and deliver predictably.

What you bring

* 5–8 years of professional Android development, with at least two apps shipped to Google Play and maintained in production.
* Expert Kotlin, including coroutines, Flow, sealed classes, extension functions and null safety, plus working knowledge of Java for legacy code.
* Deep experience with Jetpack Compose and the View system, and the judgement to migrate or mix them.
* Strong concurrency skills: coroutines, structured concurrency, Flow and StateFlow, and how to avoid leaks and lifecycle bugs.
* Solid grasp of architecture and design patterns, SOLID principles and dependency injection (Hilt, Dagger or Koin), with experience refactoring large codebases.
* Strong testing habits: JUnit, Mockito or MockK, Espresso, Compose UI tests and testable design.
* Experience with networking (Retrofit, OkHttp), persistence (Room, DataStore), caching and offline-first behaviour.
* Good understanding of app security: Keystore, certificate pinning, secure storage, R8/ProGuard and Play data-safety requirements.
* Proficiency with Git, pull-request workflows, Gradle and CI/CD.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, including Profiler, LeakCanary and Logcat.
* Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Technology skills at a glance

* **Languages:**
   Kotlin (primary), Java (working knowledge)
* **UI:**
   Jetpack Compose, Android Views, Material Design 3, accessibility (TalkBack), animations
* **Architecture:**
   MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture, multi-module Gradle projects, Android Jetpack (ViewModel, Navigation, WorkManager, Lifecycle)
* **Concurrency:**
   coroutines, Flow, StateFlow
* **Dependency injection:**
   Hilt, Dagger or Koin
* **Data and networking:**
   Retrofit, OkHttp, Moshi or Kotlin Serialization, Room, DataStore, GraphQL (Apollo)
* **Testing and quality:**
   JUnit, MockK or Mockito, Espresso, Compose UI tests, Detekt or ktlint
* **Tooling and delivery:**
   Android Studio, Profiler, Perfetto, LeakCanary, Gradle, Git, GitHub Actions, Jenkins or Bitrise, Fastlane, Google Play Console
* **Platform services:**
   Firebase Cloud Messaging, deep links and App Links, Google Play Billing, background work and permissions, Keystore
* **Observability:**
   Firebase Crashlytics or Sentry, analytics SDKs, Android vitals
* **AI-assisted engineering:**
   AI coding assistants for code, tests and documentation, with careful human review of everything they produce

Nice to have and how to apply

Senior Platform Engineer - Search
  
  
**About The Role**
AlphaSense is seeking an experienced engineer to work on the search platform that powers market intelligence across billions of documents. You'll tackle the challenge of building distributed systems that handle hundreds of queries per second with millisecond latency, while establishing engineering excellence that ensures reliability for our enterprise customers.
  
  
This role is perfect for a seasoned engineer who loves challenges and has a track record of building robust, high-performance systems. While search experience is valuable, we believe great engineers can master new domains – what matters most is your ability to build systems that scale and don't break.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Scale Distributed Systems: Architect and optimize infrastructure handling billions of documents and hundreds of queries per second
* Lead Platform Evolution: Drive the migration from legacy systems to modern architecture, ensuring zero downtime and improved performance
* Build Engineering Excellence: Establish comprehensive monitoring, testing, and deployment practices that catch issues before customers do
* Optimize Performance: Profile and tune systems from the infrastructure to the application level, balancing cost and performance

**Required**
**What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years building and operating distributed systems in production
* Experience with large-scale data platforms or high-throughput systems
* Expertise in distributed systems fundamentals: sharding, replication, consistency, partition tolerance
* Strong performance optimization skills - you can profile, diagnose, and fix bottlenecks across the stack
* Experience with data pipeline architecture, real-time processing, or database internals
* Excellence in building observable systems with comprehensive monitoring and alerting

**Preferred**

* Experience with search platforms (Vespa, Elasticsearch, Solr) or similar large-scale data systems
* Experience with Kubernetes, CRDs, and infrastructure as code
* Background in information retrieval, ranking systems, or recommendation engines

* Experience with JVM-based systems and tuning
* Knowledge of modern engineering practices from high-growth companies

You'll own a critical platform that directly impacts how customers discover insights. This isn't just about maintaining a search system – it's about building the next generation of information retrieval at scale. You'll work with modern technologies (including hybrid lexical/vector search), but more importantly, you'll apply your distributed systems expertise to solve fascinating scale challenges.
  
  
The best part? You'll join a team of smart engineers who are eager to learn. Your experience in building bulletproof systems will directly elevate the entire team's capabilities.
  
  
**Impact You'll Have**
Within your first year, you'll transform our search infrastructure from reactive to proactive, reduce latency, complete a major platform migration, and build systems that scale effortlessly with our growth. Most importantly, you'll establish engineering practices that ensure we never hear about customer issues first.

Senior iOS Developer

**Employment type:**
 Full-time · 
**Experience:**
 5–8 years

About the role

We are hiring a Senior iOS Developer to design, build and ship high-quality iOS apps used by real customers at scale. You will own features end to end, shape the app's architecture, and raise the engineering bar for the team.

This role suits an engineer with 5–8 years of hands-on iOS experience, deep Swift knowledge, strong fundamentals in architecture and testing, and the judgement to make sound technical trade-offs. You will work with product, design, backend and QA, and report to the Engineering lead.

What you will do

* Design and build iOS features end to end, from technical design through release and post-launch monitoring.
* Define and evolve the app architecture (MVVM, Clean Architecture or similar), module boundaries and dependency management.
* Write clean, testable, well-documented Swift code and set the standard through thoughtful code reviews.
* Build modern UI with SwiftUI and UIKit that follows Apple's Human Interface Guidelines and supports accessibility and Dynamic Type.
* Own performance: app launch time, memory, battery, networking, and smooth scrolling, using Instruments to find and fix bottlenecks.
* Integrate REST/GraphQL APIs, push notifications, analytics, payments and third-party SDKs securely and reliably.
* Build and maintain unit, UI and snapshot tests, and keep CI/CD pipelines (Fastlane, Xcode Cloud or similar) fast and stable.
* Manage App Store releases, TestFlight betas, crash monitoring and phased rollouts.
* Mentor mid-level and junior engineers and help the team make good technical decisions.
* Partner with product, design, backend and QA to scope work, flag risks early and deliver predictably.

What you bring

* 5–8 years of professional iOS development, with at least two apps shipped to the App Store and maintained in production.
* Expert Swift, including generics, protocols, property wrappers and value vs reference semantics, plus working knowledge of Objective-C for legacy code.
* Deep experience with UIKit and SwiftUI, and the judgement to choose between them.
* Strong concurrency skills: async/await, actors, structured concurrency, Combine and GCD, and how to avoid races and retain cycles.
* Solid grasp of architecture and design patterns, SOLID principles and dependency injection, with experience refactoring large codebases.
* Strong testing habits: XCTest, Swift Testing, UI tests, mocking and testable design.
* Experience with networking, persistence (Core Data, SwiftData, Realm or SQLite), caching and offline-first behaviour.
* Good understanding of app security: Keychain, certificate pinning, secure storage and privacy requirements (App Tracking Transparency, privacy manifests).
* Proficiency with Git, pull-request workflows and CI/CD.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, including Instruments and the Xcode debugger.
* Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Technology skills at a glance

* **Languages:**
   Swift (primary), Objective-C (working knowledge)
* **UI:**
   SwiftUI, UIKit, Auto Layout, Core Animation, accessibility (VoiceOver, Dynamic Type)
* **Architecture:**
   MVVM, Clean Architecture, VIPER or TCA, modular design with Swift Package Manager, dependency injection
* **Concurrency:**
   async/await, actors, Combine, GCD
* **Data and networking:**
   URLSession, REST, GraphQL, Codable, Core Data, SwiftData, Realm or SQLite, Keychain
* **Testing and quality:**
   XCTest, Swift Testing, XCUITest, snapshot tests, SwiftLint
* **Tooling and delivery:**
   Xcode, Instruments, Git, Fastlane, Xcode Cloud, GitHub Actions or Jenkins, TestFlight, App Store Connect
* **Platform services:**
   push notifications (APNs), deep links and Universal Links, in-app purchases (StoreKit), HealthKit, MapKit or similar frameworks as needed
* **Observability:**
   Firebase Crashlytics or Sentry, analytics SDKs, MetricKit
* **AI-assisted engineering:**
   AI coding assistants for code, tests and documentation, with careful human review of everything they produce

Nice to have and how to apply

**Nice to have**

* Experience building or maintaining an SDK or shared framework for other teams.
* Cross-platform exposure (React Native, Flutter or Kotlin Multiplatform) and a good sense of when to use it.
* Experience with on-device ML (Core ML), widgets, App Clips, watchOS or CarPlay.
* Experience with performance, security or accessibility audits.
* Open-source contributions, technical writing or conference talks.
* Experience leading a small team or acting as a tech lead.

**Education:**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* **How to apply:**
   Send your resume and links to your App Store apps, GitHub or code samples to [application email to be added]. The process includes a technical conversation about your past work, a hands-on coding or code-review round, and a system design discussion.

The team operates a Central MCP Delivery model: building critical MCP tools and services “for” product teams where required, while simultaneously defining standards, patterns, and platform capabilities that allow teams to progressively move towards self‑service contribution.
  
  
LSEG AI Assist / Internal MCP Programme of Work
  
  
This programme delivers an LSEG‑owned, production‑grade agentic AI platform with MCP as its extensibility layer.
  
  
The scope of work includes:
  
  

* Building and operating LSEG AI Assist, an in‑house agentic experience capable of reasoning, planning, and tool‑calling.
* Operating QAS, the enterprise RAG and search layer used to ground agent responses in approved data sources.
* Delivering a production Internal MCP Gateway providing discovery, security, policy enforcement, observability, and lifecycle management for MCP tools and Skills.

* Establishing evaluation, quality control, and governance mechanisms so MCP tools and Skills can be promoted through PTB/PTO and operated with confidence at scale.

title: AI/ML Engineer: SIGINT & ELINT
description:
**About the Role**

Auric AI Labs is developing the world's most advanced AI-powered vision intelligence platform for defense applications. We are building an AI-native intelligence system from scratch. No legacy DSP pipeline, no AI-as-classifier-stage, no hybrid compromises. We need an engineer to build the deep learning models that detect, classify, geolocate, and fingerprint radar and communications emitters directly from raw IQ data.

**Why this role exists**

Most “AI in SIGINT” today is AI bolted onto a 1990s DSP pipeline as a final classification stage. Filter, threshold, extract feature,
*then*
hand the leftovers to a small neural network. Each stage before the network throws away information the network could have used. Each hand-crafted feature is a prior the model is forced to inherit.

We are not doing that.

We are betting that an AI-native architecture, where deep learning operates on raw IQ data with minimal pre-processing, learns its own features, and replaces the deterministic stack rather than supplementing it, delivers a 5-10x improvement on every metric that matters: detection in low SNR, classification of unknown waveforms, specific emitter ID, real-time anomaly detection, cognitive EW.

This is not an “AI feature” inside a conventional product. The model
*is*
the product.

**The actual problems**

* **The signals are designed to defeat you:**
  A modern LPI radar deliberately spreads its energy below the noise floor. A frequency-agile emitter changes frequency every pulse. Your job is to find structure that has been deliberately hidden.
* **You will not have real training data:**
  Zero, for the signals that matter most. Before you can train a model, you have to answer a harder question: what does it mean for a model trained entirely in simulation to be trustworthy in the real world? You will design the synthetic data pipeline, the channel models, the validation methodology, and the test for knowing when your simulator is wrong.
* **Every emitter is unique:**
  Two radars of the same model number have hardware differences (oscillator drift, amplifier non-linearities, timing jitter) that fingerprint them individually. The problem is not “which class of radar,” it is “have I seen this specific transmitter before, even in a different mode, even years ago.” Open-set, fine-grained, unlabelled.
* **The DSP world will tell you it cannot be done:**
  Some of their reasons are right. You will need to engage with them honestly, then figure out which ones are wrong and why.

**Who we are looking for**

Not a list of traits, those describe nothing. Specific, observable things we will recognise when we see them:

* **AI-native instinct:**
  Your first instinct on a new problem is not “what filter, transform, or heuristic applies here” but “what should a learned function take in, what should it output, and what is the right inductive bias.” You think in terms of data, loss, and architecture the way a DSP engineer thinks in filter coefficients. You see hand-engineered features as priors to be questioned, not assumed.
* **You reason about whether a model fits its data:**
  Not just whether it trains. You can look at a problem and argue, before writing code, why a particular architecture is or is not suited to the structure of the data it will see. You know that complex-valued signals, long-range temporal dependencies, and small distribution shifts each break specific assumptions, and you can name which.
* **You design experiments that can fail:**
  Most ML work tunes until the loss goes down. Yours starts with the question: what result would prove I am wrong. You build the falsifying test before you build the model. With synthetic data and no real ground truth, this discipline is the entire difference between research that works and research that only seems to.
* **You read papers to find what the authors did not say:**
  You reproduce a paper and notice the seed dependence the authors quietly omitted, the dataset preprocessing buried in the appendix, the hyperparameter that does most of the work. This habit is rare and it is what separates engineers who absorb a field from engineers who collect summaries of it.
* **The best work on your CV is work nobody assigned:**
  A paper you reproduced because the result seemed too clean. A side project that became four months. An idea you kept thinking about after the class or job that introduced it had ended. The single hardest thing to fake.
* **You can turn a vague objective into a defensible ML problem:**
  “Detect this radar” is not a specification. You can take an objective in plain English, decide what the inputs are, what the outputs should be, what the right loss is, and what evaluation would actually mean the system works in the field. This translation is most of the job.

PHINIA is seeking a Manufacturing Systems Engineer to act as a key bridge between Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT) across our global manufacturing network. **Key Responsibilities**

* Configure and maintain OPC‑UA servers and clients (Kepware, Matrikon, native Siemens/Rockwell servers) including certificate management, namespace configuration, subscription tuning, and high‑tag‑count performance optimization.

* Support MES platform implementations and migrations (Rockwell FTPC/MES, Siemens OpCenter, Ignition, or equivalent), including system configuration, operator workflow setup, and production validation.
* Develop and maintain real‑time dashboards and monitoring tools; integrate time‑series data from sensors/PLCs/historians for operational insights (OEE, downtime, scrap, quality trends).
* Train and mentor plant engineers on data extraction techniques, OPC‑UA configuration, and historian usage to build local self‑sufficiency and reduce dependency on central IT.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation including plant integration maps, tag lists, network diagrams, configuration guides, and runbooks.
* Ensure all shopfloor solutions meet PHINIA’s standards for reliability, cybersecurity, ISA/IEC 62443 alignment, Zero Trust, and data integrity.
* Contribute to digital manufacturing initiatives including IIoT enablement, machine connectivity, predictive analytics, and smart‑factory programs.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Automation, Manufacturing Systems, or related technical field
* 6–10 years of experience in manufacturing IT, OT systems, or shopfloor application development/integration
* Hands‑on experience with Rockwell and/or Siemens automation platforms: RSLogix/Studio 5000, FactoryTalk, TIA Portal, WinCC, or their respective historians
* Practical OPC‑UA experience: configuring servers/clients, certificate management, namespace browsing, subscription vs. polling tuning, high‑tag‑count performance
* Experience setting up and configuring data historians (PI, FactoryTalk Historian, WinCC archives, or similar)
* Multi‑protocol integration fluency: OPC‑UA, MQTT, SOAP, REST, AMQP — with comfort reading and debugging JSON, XML, and SOAP payloads
* SQL fluency (joins, window functions, query optimization) for data mining against production databases
* Big data awareness: familiarity with time‑series databases, data lake concepts, and streaming ingestion patterns
* Basic algorithm understanding (sorting, searching, complexity analysis)
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes: traceability, quality checks, OEE, work instructions, operator workflows, machine data capture
* Experience with plant‑floor networking: VLANs, DMZ, edge devices, IoT gateways, barcode/RFID/scanner workflows
* Experience with IT/OT cybersecurity principles, network segmentation, and secured industrial architecture
* Ability to influence without authority and get results in environments with resistant or under‑resourced plant teams
* Patience, diplomacy, and strong communication skills for working with plant‑floor technicians, maintenance teams, and local management
* MES platform certifications (Rockwell, Siemens, Ignition) — preferred
* Microsoft Azure certifications (AZ‑900, AZ‑204) — preferred
* IT/OT security certifications (ISA/IEC 62443 awareness) — preferred
